_note: Human-authored ground truth for the printed Speedrunners block tiles (sp-en-blocks-a4), from source review. It is authoritative for detection targets and data authoring; exact zone ids (h1..h7 per space) are left to the editor, while space SHAPES/COUNTS, open-edge counts, bonus corners, ICE, direction arrows, and ICE modifiers are source-verified. Keyed by asset id.
_iceModel: ICE has two distinct printed forms: (1) ICE DIFFICULTY sits at a hex CORNER (a die / 3-D dice showing the value; a BLACK die means Black ICE) and sets the block's iceValue/iceFaces/blackIce; (2) an ICE MODIFIER sits INSIDE a space/zone (a flat die on that zone) and is a space.modifier{kind:ice, amount}. Detection must not conflate the two.

spaces.note: a single huge area covering the whole tile; the only space this large in the set
one zone carries an ICE modifier (a flat die on the zone)
